gui.maidhome_bridge.uncertain: Outcome uncertain: check both games and records
gui.maidhome_bridge.own_task: Task active here; closing this screen will not cancel it
gui.maidhome_bridge.occupied: Platform is occupied by another task
gui.maidhome_bridge.no_maid: Bring one maid onto the central pad
gui.maidhome_bridge.many_maids: Multiple maids on the pad; leave only one
gui.maidhome_bridge.ready: Target recognized; select a mode to send
gui.maidhome_bridge.move_hint: Move: remove the MC maid only after commit and server checks
gui.maidhome_bridge.copy_hint: Copy: MC maid stays; duplicate import is blocked while she lives
gui.maidhome_bridge.receive_hint: In MaidHome, put the maid in your bag and click Send
gui.maidhome_bridge.archive_only: Only the maid archive returns, not model assets; ACK has no reply
gui.maidhome_bridge.selection_hint: Command selection never replaces the maid on this platform
gui.maidhome_bridge.confirm_remove: Remove committed maid on this pad
gui.maidhome_bridge.wand_hint: Hold a MineToMesh export wand in either hand
gui.maidhome_bridge.missing_minetomesh: Install MineToMesh for houses; other pages remain available
gui.maidhome_bridge.house_allowed: Read, edit and send the existing wand selection
gui.maidhome_bridge.house_denied: House export requires singleplayer or server permission level 2
gui.maidhome_bridge.house_hint: Apply edits before sending. Include floor and headroom; keep the building unchanged
gui.maidhome_bridge.selection_loaded: Selection read / saved to the actual export wand
gui.maidhome_bridge.sound_exists: Same sound ID exists; content equality and freshness are unverified
gui.maidhome_bridge.sound_not_verified: Remote existence unverified; connect and refresh
gui.maidhome_bridge.sound_independent: Independent upload needs no maid on the pad; same ID replaces remote sounds
gui.maidhome_bridge.original_sound_hint: Existing sound action: select a maid and connect first
gui.maidhome_bridge.list_hint: Lists are read-only: no remote deletion or request to send a maid
gui.maidhome_bridge.no_results: No data; connect and refresh, or view saved records
gui.maidhome_bridge.endpoint_hint: Default: 127.0.0.1:7411. Start the Portal in MaidHome first
gui.maidhome_bridge.invalid_endpoint: Enter a host and a port from 1 to 65535
gui.maidhome_bridge.station_invalid: Platform invalid, out of range, or server unavailable
gui.maidhome_bridge.confirm_copy: Send a copy of the maid on this pad to MaidHome, uploading missing sounds first. The MC maid stays, so duplicate imports remain blocked. Inventory follows MaidFileManager rules and is not guaranteed to transfer fully. Continue?
gui.maidhome_bridge.confirm_move: Move the maid on this pad to MaidHome. First remove all inventory, equipment, baubles and extra backpacks. The server blocks removal otherwise. The MC maid is removed only after successful commit and another server check. Continue?
gui.maidhome_bridge.confirm_receive_impo: Receive and import onto this platform. Keep the pad and headroom clear, then click Send from the MaidHome bag. ACK is sent only after permission, duplicate and spawn checks succeed. Waiting lasts up to 5 minutes; closing this screen does not stop it.
gui.maidhome_bridge.confirm_receive_save: Save the returning archive without spawning a maid. After durable saving, a success ACK allows MaidHome to remove its copy. The local backup stays. Click Send in the MaidHome bag. Continue?
gui.maidhome_bridge.confirm_sound: Upload this sound pack. An existing pack with the same ID in MaidHome will be replaced. Local resources and upload backups remain. Continue?
gui.maidhome_bridge.confirm_acknowledge: Acknowledge only after checking the MC entity, MaidHome bag and backup records. This does not retry, spawn or delete a maid, or clear import deduplication. Have you checked the outcome?
